answer: Because the fable cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the reef ledger, the quill audit makes public how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 17 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That is 32 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
